statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_table (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, data VARCHAR(255))

INSERT INTO test_table (data) SELECT CONCAT('row_', n) FROM (SELECT @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS n FROM (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4) t1, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4) t2, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4) t3, (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4) t4, (SELECT @rownum := 0) t5 LIMIT 1000) numbers
